name: AffiliateTracker Connector
author: I-Creativi

sections.description:
AffiliateTracker Connector links your WooCommerce store to AffiliateTracker, an affiliate tracking platform for e-commerce. Your affiliates and influencers get a personal referral link, every order they bring is recorded with its commission, and they follow their results from the My Account page of your store: no external portal and no extra password.

What the plugin does in your store

  • Recognizes visitors arriving from an affiliate link (?referral=CODE, parameter name configurable) and remembers them with a first-party cookie for the duration you choose.
  • Sends new orders and every status change to the platform, from both the classic checkout and the block checkout.
  • Adds an affiliate area to My Account: application form, earnings, orders, the influencer’s own discount code, the influencer’s bank details for payouts, credit balance and conversion of credit into a native WooCommerce coupon.
  • Influencer discount codes: the code you assign to an influencer on the platform becomes a WooCommerce coupon (or is linked to the coupon you already have), and orders placed with it are credited to the influencer even without a click.
  • Adds an AffiliateTracker page under WooCommerce in wp-admin: connection settings, affiliates (approve, suspend, change commission), program tiers, last 6 months, latest attributed orders and CSV export.
  • Runs an hourly maintenance task (WP-Cron) that resends orders that did not reach the platform, refreshes recent order statuses, completes pending coupons and keeps the influencer coupons in line with the platform. The platform can also ask for this task right away (a request signed with your store API key) when you assign or change a code.

What the platform does

  • Calculates commissions with your rules: percentage per program or per affiliate, first order only, all orders of the customer or only orders within the link duration.
  • Cancels the commission automatically when an order is refunded or cancelled.
  • Tiers, monthly reports to you and to every affiliate, team access, CSV exports.
  • Data stored in a European data center.

Requirements

An AffiliateTracker subscription is required: the plugin is the store-side connector of the platform and does nothing on its own. Plans start at €99/month (VAT excluded), based on the store’s yearly revenue, with every feature included. See pricing.

External services

This plugin connects to the AffiliateTracker platform (https://affiliatetracker.it), operated by i-creativi s.r.l.s., Milan, Italy. The connection is needed to record affiliate visits and orders and to calculate commissions. Nothing is sent until you enter your store API key in WooCommerce → AffiliateTracker.

Data sent, and when:

  • Affiliate visits: when a visitor arrives from an affiliate link, the affiliate code, the landing URL, the optional campaign name and the browser user agent are sent. The user agent is only used to leave out clicks from bots (link previews, search engines, crawlers) and is not stored. No IP address or personal data of the visitor.
  • Orders: when an order is created or changes status, the order ID, the WooCommerce customer ID, the billing email, the coupon codes used, the referral code and campaign (if any), the order status, totals (paid, products, shipping) and the currency. The coupon codes attribute orders to the influencer who owns the code; the email recognizes an influencer who uses their own code.
  • Influencer discount codes: with the maintenance task, the result of each code in the store (created, linked, disabled) and its discount. When you assign a code, the same order data as above is sent for the orders placed with that code since 1 January, to credit them to the influencer.
  • Affiliate area: when a logged-in customer opens the affiliate area in My Account or applies to the program, their WordPress user ID and email (plus their name when applying), to find or create their affiliate record. When an influencer enters or changes their bank details for payouts, the account holder name and IBAN, stored on the platform so the store can pay their earnings by bank transfer.
  • Store revenue: with the hourly maintenance task, the total of paid orders of the last 12 months and the store currency, used to check the subscription band.
  • Admin pages: when you open the AffiliateTracker page in wp-admin, the plugin reads affiliates, commissions, tiers and statistics from the platform.

Terms of service: https://affiliatetracker.it/en/terms
Privacy policy: https://affiliatetracker.it/en/privacy
sections.installation:
1. Activate your program on affiliatetracker.it and copy the store API key from your dashboard.
  2. Install and activate the plugin (WooCommerce must be active).
  3. Go to WooCommerce → AffiliateTracker, paste the API key and save.
  4. Share the affiliate links: https://yourstore.com/?referral=CODE.

Most stores need nothing else. If your store has little traffic or DISABLE_WP_CRON is set, the settings page explains how to schedule an external cron.
sections.faq:
Is the plugin free?

The plugin is free and open source (GPL). It needs an AffiliateTracker subscription to work, because tracking, commissions and history live on the platform.

Do affiliates need an account on another website?

No. They apply and follow their results from the My Account page of your store, with their usual customer account.

What happens when an order is refunded?

The status change reaches the platform and the commission is cancelled automatically.

Does it work with the block checkout?

Yes, orders from both the classic checkout and the block checkout (Store API) are tracked.

Are influencer discount codes supported?

Yes. Assign a code to an influencer on the platform: the plugin creates the WooCommerce coupon (non-cumulative, whole catalog, no expiry) or links the coupon you already have, and orders placed with the code are credited to the influencer even without a click. Orders placed with the code since 1 January are recovered when you assign it.

Which languages are available?

English. Translations, Italian included, are managed on translate.wordpress.org.
sections.changelog:
0.20.0

  • Influencer coupons created by the plugin now follow the rules you choose on the platform: exclude sale items, minimum spend, expiry date, usage limits (total and per customer), allowed together with other coupons, free shipping. Coupons already created by the plugin are updated when the rules change; coupons you created yourself are never touched.

0.19.0

  • Clicks from bots (link previews in chat apps, search engines, crawlers) no longer count: the visitor’s user agent is sent with each click, including clicks resent from the queue, so the platform can leave them out.
  • Influencers can enter their account holder and IBAN for bank transfer payouts in the affiliate area of My Account. Only the last four digits are shown back.

0.18.2

  • All functions, classes, options, meta keys, hooks and the database table now use the atcwc prefix. Existing settings and data are moved over automatically on update.
  • Stricter nonce and capability checks on the My Account forms.
  • Translation files are no longer bundled: they are delivered by translate.wordpress.org.

0.18.1

  • All texts are now written in English in the code, with the Italian translation shipped in the plugin.
  • The affiliate area in My Account moved from /my-account/affiliato/ to /my-account/affiliate/ (rewrite rules are refreshed automatically).

0.18.0

  • Influencer discount codes, as in the PrestaShop module: coupon created or linked, disabled when the influencer is deactivated, orders with the code attributed even without a click, recovery of the orders since 1 January, code shown in My Account.
  • The platform can request the maintenance task right away with a signed request.
  • Fix: the maintenance task stopped with a fatal error when a refund had been made in the last 60 days.

0.17.3

  • Form input sanitized and unslashed everywhere (Plugin Check). Tested with WordPress 7.1 and WooCommerce 11.2.

0.17.2

  • readme.txt and plugin headers for the WordPress.org plugin directory.

0.17.1

  • Latest release before the WordPress.org submission. Full history in CHANGELOG.md.
